summary: ITER167 Round 4 — Real Mobile QA. Backend 11/11 pytest pass (identify enumeration-safe, silent-magic-link no leak, /api/public/journeys/initiate accepts country_code/dial_code/normalized_phone, magic_link email template editorial + dark-mode meta). Frontend mobile 414x900: PhoneCountryPrefix dropdown present, Italy default (🇮🇹 +39), menu opens, US click switches trigger to (🇺🇸 +1). 3-step /begin-journey flow completes without /auth/login redirect; final CTA transitions to cinematic 'Stiamo aprendo il tuo Design Journey™…' inline view. /journey/preparing stable >5s with 'Maria' personalization. /auth/recovery editorial (no banned terms). /auth/login Adaptive Access™ probe→client→sent flow works (sent title 'Ti abbiamo inviato un accesso personale.' visible).

ui_bugs.issue: Massive horizontal overflow: scrollWidth=1480, innerWidth=414 (1066px overflow). UL.mfd-trust__brands is 1263px wide and LI.mfd-trust__brand items extend to right=1260px. Violates P1 'scrollWidth ≤ innerWidth' requirement.
React warning: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' — invalid setState during render on /auth/login.

25 missing i18n keys on /auth/login (auth.access.eyebrow, auth.access.probe.title/subtitle/cta, auth.access.client.title/subtitle/cta_email/cta_password, auth.access.professional.*, auth.access.sent.title/copy/resend, auth.access.quote/quote_author/need_help/support/support_email, auth.login.hero_image/brand_logo). Page still renders correct Italian fallback copy, but registry strings must be seeded.

issues: FOOTER.mfd-footer is full-width pure black, 761px tall — directive says 'NO fascia nera'. Borderline: this is the standard dark footer, but flagged for review against editorial spec.

action_items: Fix homepage mobile horizontal overflow (.mfd-trust__brands) on viewport 414 — likely needs flex-wrap, max-width:100%, or marquee/overflow:hidden container.
Seed missing 25 editorial_blocks keys auth.access.* + auth.login.* (it-IT) so /auth/login no longer relies on hard-coded fallback.
Investigate React 'setState during render' warning on /auth/login (LoginPage Adaptive Access phase machine).
Confirm whether full-width black FOOTER on mobile homepage is the intended editorial 'fascia nera' or needs softer treatment.
critical_code_review_comments: P0 PhoneCountryPrefix DB-driven dropdown: works, Italy default, US switch (🇺🇸 +1). data-testids exposed (bj-phone-prefix-trigger/menu/option-XX) — excellent.
Backend /api/public/journeys/initiate accepts welcome.country_code/dial_code/normalized_phone without 422 and returns continuity surface (welcome_url/magic_link_url/welcome_token). 201 Created.

Email render('magic_link') contains: subject 'spazio progettuale ti aspetta', html 'Bentornato, Maria.', 'Vorrei una casa', 'Apri il tuo spazio progettuale', 'Stefano Ogrisek', 'Con cura', AND dark-mode meta (color-scheme dark light + supported-color-schemes + @media prefers-color-scheme:dark). All P1 email assertions satisfied.
Identify endpoint enumeration-safe: identical key shape for admin (professional/password_exists:true) vs unknown (client/password_exists:false).
/auth/login renders fallback IT copy even with 25 missing keys — defensive UX is good, but registry should still be seeded.
Horizontal overflow on homepage trust strip is the only meaningful P1 regression — easily fixable but blocks 'no horizontal overflow' P1 acceptance.

success_rate.frontend: P0 100% (phone prefix + 3-step flow + preparing + recovery + adaptive login OK); P1 60% (home overflow + missing i18n keys regressions)

seed_data_creation: Created multiple unique TEST_ journey leads via /api/public/journeys/initiate (maria<timestamp>@example.com). No manual cleanup performed; data is journey-scoped and additive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phone prefix testids confirmed: bj-phone-prefix-trigger / bj-phone-prefix-menu / bj-phone-prefix-option-{COUNTRY_CODE} (e.g. -IT, -US, -GB). BeginJourneyPage uses 0-indexed steps (step 0 = ATMOSFERA spaces+textareas; step 1 = COME VIVI guests+ambiance; step 2 = CONOSCIAMOCI form). Space chip values are English keys (home, showroom, hospitality, office, other) while backend payload uses Italian tokens (casa, da_soli, caldi_avvolgenti) — frontend maps internally on submit. The backend journey endpoint is /api/public/journeys/initiate (NOT /api/journey/initiate) and returns 201. Final CTA on step 2 renders inline cinematic preparing view on same /begin-journey path (does NOT navigate to /journey/preparing) — verify with main agent whether this is intended.
rca of the issue: Homepage mobile overflow: UL.mfd-trust__brands keeps a fixed-width horizontal layout (1263px) on a 414px viewport, with no flex-wrap / overflow:hidden / scroll-snap marquee container. Fix likely in /app/frontend/src/styles for .mfd-trust__brands (add flex-wrap:wrap or wrap into a horizontally-scrolling marquee with overflow-x:hidden on parent and translate-X animation).
